survivingClaim: Precise obstruction for the four named degree-2 constructions; no statement about zeros. (a) Log-level squares with positive multiplicities are linear in -L'/L and lie inside the P25 cone. (b) A product of two log-level forms has non-negative coefficients at n = pq only if both factors have non-negative prime coefficients up to a common sign (proved for zeta shifts with X the orbit closure; with companions relative to a cited Sato-Tate joint density). (c) Coefficient squares sum |b(n)|^2 n^-s are non-negative for every sequence b, invariant under every unimodular twist, and stay non-negative for Davenport-Heilbronn (sum a(n)^2 n^-s = ((1+kappa^2)/2)(1-5^-s) zeta(s) + ((1-kappa^2)/2) L(s,(./5)), exact). (d) For b = lambda_Pi (positive integer multiplicities, tempered, unramified factors) the series equals L(s, Pi x Pi~) H(s) with log H = O_d(1) on sigma >= 1, and its Landau abscissa is 1 - 2 min Re z_j for every zero configuration, so the Landau device on a coefficient square reaches Re s = 1 only. DH fails the product forms through one coefficient value at n = 3, not at a multiplicative step; the only multiplicative step (factorisation of the coefficient square) supports classical non-vanishing on Re s = 1 and nothing to the left. Density (family) forms were not run.
obstruction: Degree-2 positive forms split into three classes. Log-level squares are linear in -L'/L and lie in the P25 cone. Products of two log-level forms are non-negative at n = pq only if both factors are already admissible linear forms (Lemma Q; with companions relative to a cited Sato-Tate joint density). Coefficient squares sum |b(n)|^2 n^-s are non-negative for every sequence, invariant under every unimodular twist, and non-negative for DH (exact). For b = lambda_Pi the series is L(s, Pi x Pi~) H(s) and its Landau abscissa is fixed by the leading pole for every zero configuration: the device reaches Re s = 1 only. Density (family) forms not run (MV-CAP).

lesson: A coefficient square |b(n)|^2 is positive without any multiplicativity and is blind to unimodular twists (THIN included). Multiplicativity enters only through factorising the series into L-functions, and at the leading pole every factor is evaluated on Re s >= 1. So quadratic coefficient positivity cannot see inside the strip, and DH passes everything except the factorisation.
